tvShow.name: Beauty in Black
tvShow.overview: A stripper's fate takes a turn when she crosses paths with the wealthy, dysfunctional family behind a cosmetics dynasty and a devious trafficking scheme.

episodes.name: Make It Rain
episodes.overview: In a bid to escape the strip club and Jules' control, Kimmie applies for a scholarship to the Beauty in Black hair school founded by the Bellarie family.

episodes.name: A Dance with Daddy
episodes.overview: Mallory and Roy try to outmaneuver a chaotic string of events. Kimmie defies orders to help Rain and forges a pact with a secretive, powerful client.

episodes.name: The Aftermath
episodes.overview: Kimmie's choices lead to dangerous consequences. Tension builds between the Bellaries as a furious Norman hunts for answers about the hit and run.

episodes.name: A Family Affair
episodes.overview: Olivia plays hardball to protect her sons. Angel comes to Kimmie with a daring proposal. As the lawsuit escalates, Mallory contemplates her options.

episodes.name: Unraveling Threads
episodes.overview: After Angel's world gets rocked, Kimmie reconsiders his idea. Jules pulls the family's strings. Faced with a difficult choice, Norman's suspicions grow.

episodes.name: Bang Bang
episodes.overview: Roy's ego reaches new heights as Mallory hunts for his "other woman." Kimmie and Angel look for a way out. Norman's grief takes a bloody turn.

episodes.name: Even Playing Field
episodes.overview: Fed up with Roy, Mallory takes matters into her own hands. As Norman digs for the truth, a familiar face comes into focus. Kimmie and Angel make moves.

episodes.name: Killing Karma
episodes.overview: Schemes and secrets come full circle as Horace connects the dots behind the robbery, Mallory asserts her dominance, and Kimmie hits her breaking point.

episodes.name: Blind Rage
episodes.overview: Emotions run high as the Bellarie family grieves and schemes. Fueled by vengeance, Kimmie begins a desperate search for her kidnapped sister, Sylvie.

episodes.name: Power Struggle
episodes.overview: Kimmie's hunt for clues leads to a hostile reunion. Jules does what he does best: clean up the mess. Horace zeroes in on Norman's criminal dealings.

episodes.name: Up Against the Wall
episodes.overview: A worsening lawsuit is the least of Mallory's problems as Horace sows chaos. Kimmie takes her search for Sylvie to dangerous new heights.

episodes.name: Hot Seat
episodes.overview: Jules and his men search for Kimmie. Angel plays a precarious game to stay alive. Varney finds himself in the crosshairs of another Bellarie scandal.

episodes.name: By Any Means
episodes.overview: Horace proposes a deal to help Kimmie find Sylvie. Can she trust him? Meanwhile, Angel makes a disturbing discovery in the club.

episodes.name: Wild Ride
episodes.overview: Money talks when Mallory traces Roy's infidelity back to the strip club. A brazen attempt to rescue Sylvie drags Kimmie into deeper danger.

episodes.name: The Lion's Den
episodes.overview: Horace's endgame puts the Bellaries on high alert. Olivia bides her time. Angel and Rain contemplate next steps. Kimmie inadvertently makes the news.

episodes.name: Now Make It Thunder
episodes.overview: The tables turn when Horace asks Kimmie for help. Astounded, the Bellaries scramble to maintain their hold on their empire.

episodes.name: Crowned in Beauty
episodes.overview: Kimmie's sudden rise sends shockwaves through the Bellarie empire, as Horace's backroom maneuvers hit the family where it hurts most — the bottom line.

episodes.name: When the Tables Turn
episodes.overview: Kimmie, Rain and Sylvie enjoy their luxurious new lifestyle. Roy uses his leverage to dominate a rival. Things get ugly as Jules and Angel square off.

episodes.name: Blaze of Beauty
episodes.overview: A sibling showdown exposes grudges too deep to reconcile. Norman takes care of unfinished business. Olivia crashes a dinner for two.

episodes.name: The Next Chapter
episodes.overview: A deadly development shatters Kimmie's trust. At Delinda's, a dancer targets a VIP for a potential payday. Rain pumps Alex for info on Angel.

episodes.name: Hunter's Prey
episodes.overview: A meeting with Horace pulls Kimmie deeper into the game. Rain hits the club with a score to settle. Charles brings home more than he bargained for.

episodes.name: The Enemy of My Enemy
episodes.overview: Rain and Alex handle cleanup duty. A vicious insult leaves Roy dripping with rage. Kimmie's poolside breakfast comes with a side of shade.

episodes.name: Gloves Off
episodes.overview: Fireworks ignite at the office as Kimmie shows the Bellaries who's boss. A rugged ranch hand welcomes Sylvie to the stables. Jules smells a rat.

episodes.name: Hold the Pleasantries
episodes.overview: The boardroom becomes a battlefield as Kimmie and the family face off. Charles and Rain make impulsive decisions with dangerous consequences.

episodes.name: Toxic Vibes
episodes.overview: A violent wake-up call leaves Charles shaken and desperate. Kimmie attempts to control the narrative. Felicia and Mallory strike a bargain.

episodes.name: Playing for Keeps
episodes.overview: A tense dinner puts Kimmie and Sylvie's bond to the test. Olivia proves that loyalty has a price. Angel's new lifestyle fuels his worst instincts.

episodes.name: Fed Up
episodes.overview: Roy spirals out in public. Unwanted guests hammer home a warning to Olivia. Kimmie tries to keep her cards close as Jules runs game.

episodes.name: Flames of Fury
episodes.overview: Angel discovers Horace's generosity has limits. Charles overplays his hand with Varney. Kimmie and Mallory have a meeting of the minds.

episodes.name: Boom!
episodes.overview: Kimmie's mandate puts Charles and Roy at risk. Rain takes on an ambitious business venture. A shocking revelation upends Norman's world.

episodes.name: Your Turn Is Coming
episodes.overview: Kimmie cautiously weighs an unlikely alliance. Jules menaces a suspect who knows more than she's saying. A stakeout turns into a white-knuckle pursuit.

episodes.name: The Power of Us
episodes.overview: Hungry for payback, three queens deliver an overdue reckoning. Left high and dry, Angel pleads for mercy. Norman presses Olivia for answers.

episodes.name: Queen's Gambit
episodes.overview: Kimmie and the Bellaries face off at an explosive shareholder summit, where secrets spill, loyalties fray — and the sharpest move is saved for last.

episodes.name: King In Play
episodes.overview: In the wake of the FBI raid, an immunity deal pits the Bellaries against each other. Meanwhile, Kimmie and Horace celebrate a fragile victory.

episodes.name: Gotcha
episodes.overview: Rain discovers that her takeover of the club comes with strings attached. Roy offers up info to the feds. Angel tries to get back on Horace's good side.

episodes.name: Throne Of Blood
episodes.overview: Olivia discovers her cellmates aren't strangers while Norman applies leverage to a bureau contact. Kimmie's attempt at seduction shakes things up.

episodes.name: A Tender Betrayal
episodes.overview: Varney makes a play to extract information from Olivia. Tensions boil over at the mansion when Sylvie threatens to reveal an explosive truth.

episodes.name: Devil In The Details
episodes.overview: While Horace uncovers a vicious betrayal, Charles maneuvers to secure his own safety. Mallory warms up to an unexpected new man in her life.

episodes.name: A Pack Of Wolves
episodes.overview: The Bellaries' feud reaches deadly new heights. Horace meets with Jules and demands answers. Rain's power trip at the club grows reckless and violent.

episodes.name: The Looking Glass
episodes.overview: A stunning secret comes to light as Horace leads Charles and Varney behind closed doors. While crises tear at Kimmie, Jules schemes for his freedom.

episodes.name: Dancing in the Rain
episodes.overview: As the Bellarie empire teeters on the brink, Kimmie and Mallory struggle to contain the fallout while chaos and bloodshed close in from all sides.
